reproduction.rationale: Identical original Figure5/6 populations, observations, metrics and companion controls must be delivered in paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions, with author code the only information addition. Original source identities, authentic input and author-code manifests, full granular analysis/verifier, exposure policy and cumulative budgets are absent. The accepted PETH component and published aggregates are insufficient for a frozen paired protocol.
